latest.title: Nigel Farage Reacts to Clacton By-Election
latest.desc:
The Clacton by-election results are in and Nigel Farage won, we asked him about this race last month, and this was his reaction.

In this clip, Nigel Farage and Konstantin Kisin discuss political strategy, voter turnout, and the Kalshi prediction market on the by-election.
